newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stad Rotterdam targets 8 pct net growth.
newsitem.headline: Stad Rotterdam targets 8 pct net growth.

text.p: Insurance firm Stad Rotterdam Anno 1720 NV said on Thursday it was targeting average net profit growth of at least eight percent per year over the coming years.
"For the coming years our target is to realise an average growth of net profit of at least eight percent per year," the insurer said in a statement.
Stad Rotterdam earlier reported 1996 net profits up 17.6 percent at 156.9 million guilders versus 133.4 million guilders in 1995.
It said that profit growth had been braked in the early 1990s due to poor results from car insurance.
"Only in 1994 was our group able to show a total profit rise of 10.4 percent, followed by an increase in net profit in 1995 of 16.4 percent and of 17.6 percent in 1996," it said.
It added that its dividend policy would continue to be characterised by a relatively high pay-out percentage, and that it would continue to offer the option of a stock dividend.
"The value of the (shares) to be paid out will be as much as possible in line with the cash dividend," it added.
